## Big idea

Let Google (or other IdP) prove who the user is. Your app receives identity tokens / codes.

## Practice

Configure OAuth2 client for Google login in Boot. Complete redirect login. Read principal name.

## Reasoning

You delegate password storage to the IdP. Still authorize *your* APIs yourself.
